ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - WinPwn Execution - ScriptBlock
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects scriptblock text keywords indicative of potential usge of the tool WinPwn. A tool for Windows and Active Directory reconnaissance and exploitation.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Offline\\_Winpwn.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*WinPwn\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*WinPwn\\\.exe.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*WinPwn\\\.ps1.*"))
